You know what zhongyuan ghost festival is?

It is believed by southern chinese that during zhongyuan festival falls on the middle of the ghost month. It is the month where the deceased get their 'holiday' and visits the Earth for a month. The Gods of Hell preside this festival to ensure the ghosts do not do stupis things on Earth. 

This is when Chinese make offerings to their deceased parents and give thanks to the Gods of Hell. They also prepare large feasts and festivities so that other ghosts can join in the celebrations as well.
